paragraphs.text: Bjorna , Nightfall Alchemist , is a legendary human from Innistrad .

Bjorna is a human alchemist and Cathar of the Church of Avacyn . Cathars are the holy warriors of the Church. Their regiments are trained on the Elgaud Grounds in Nephalia . As a Nightfall Duelist, she is a soldier who patrols the streets of Nephalia, particularly at night, on the lookout for thieves, vampires , and corpse traders. She appears as an older light-skinned woman with white hair who is equipped with numerous alchemical vials strapped to her clothing. Her vials appear to be able to generate lightning and explosions and she is seen with a somewhat crazed expression on her face when they are used.
